title: Work email not syncing on phone, fixed on call
notes: Resolved low-priority call. Caller gives no contact detail, so contact_info must stay 'Not mentioned' - exercises the hallucination check. All data is synthetic.
transcript: Speaker 1: SSM Repak support, this is Lucas. How can I help you today?
Speaker 2: Hi Lucas, my name is Sophie Bakker. My work email has stopped syncing on my phone, new messages only show up when I open it on my laptop.
Speaker 1: Happy to help with that, Sophie. Can I take your account reference?
Speaker 1: Thanks. It's not urgent if the laptop still works, so we'll just get the phone sorted. Which phone are you using?
Speaker 2: An Android phone, the standard mail app.
Speaker 1: Let's start simple. Open the mail app settings, find the account, and toggle Sync off and then on again.
Speaker 2: Okay... I've done that. Nothing new yet.
Speaker 1: Now check that background data is allowed for the mail app, sometimes a battery-saver setting blocks it.
Speaker 2: Oh, you're right, background data was switched off. I've turned it on now... and the new emails are coming through.
Speaker 1: That was the cause, the battery saver had blocked background sync.
Speaker 2: That's fantastic, thank you so much. I'd been struggling with that for a week.
Speaker 1: Glad it's sorted. Your email is syncing normally again. Anything else?
Speaker 2: No, that's perfect. Really appreciate it, Lucas.
